C1190.title: Capital One 2019 Data Breach
C1190.summary: On July 19, 2019, Capital One confirmed that an outside individual had gained unauthorized access to personal information associated with credit-card applications, affecting about 100 million people in the United States and 6 million in Canada. The company said credit-card account numbers and login credentials were not compromised and fewer than one percent of Social Security numbers were affected. The FBI arrested the suspect, and the government said it believed the data had been recovered.
